name: combobox-40
description: Admin users table filtered live by a clearable role combobox.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Badge } from "@workspace/ui/components/badge" import { Combobox, ComboboxContent, ComboboxInput, ComboboxItem, ComboboxList, } from "@workspace/ui/components/combobox" import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow, } from "@workspace/ui/components/table" const users = [ { name: "Ali Imam", email: "ali@designali.com", role: "Owner" }, { name: "Sara", email: "sara@designali.com", role: "Admin" }, { name: "Omar", email: "omar@designali.com", role: "Member" }, { name: "Nina", email: "nina@designali.com", role: "Member" }, { name: "Client", email: "client@example.com", role: "Guest" }, ] const roles = ["Owner", "Admin", "Member", "Guest"] export default function AdminTableRoleFilter() { const [role, setRole] = React.useState(null) const rows = role ? users.filter((user) => user.role === role) : users return (
Members · {rows.length} {(item: string) => ( {item} )}
Name Role {rows.map((user) => (
{user.name}
{user.email}
{user.role} ))}
) }
